text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — ran a multigpu end-to-end profile on 13B with the new mem-saver mode (aggressive activation checkpointing + layer fusion off). Peak GPU mem down ~28% but p99 per-token latency up ~18% on TP=4, PP=2.
perfbot: perf summary -> all-reduce avg 1.6ms -> 2.1ms, extra recompute overhead ~0.9ms/step, overlap estimated ~12%.
Kevin Liu: Can you paste the exact config & a short perf snippet? Curious if kernel selection flipped because of seq_len distribution.
Maria Chen: Config: TP=4 PP=2, micro-batch=2, seq_len dist ~ 1024/512 avg, kernels=auto (cuBLAS -> fused), mem-saver=true, kv_cache=true. Snippet:
```
AllReduce(avg): before=1.6ms after=2.1ms
Forward(ms): before=9.8ms after=12.6ms
Recompute(ms): 0 -> 0.9ms
Overlap estimate: 12%
``` 
Sasha Patel: Hypothesis — recompute causes extra mini-forwards across PP stage boundaries which means activation slices are sent multiple times. In PP those sends serialize with all-reduces so we lose overlap.
Oliver Grant: Confirmed in my toy runs: when we recompute near a stage boundary there's an extra 0.3-0.5ms of cross-stage traffic from repeated activation sends. Logs:
```
[stage1->stage2] send act size=2.4MB time=0.42ms
[stage1->stage2] send act(recompute)=2.4MB time=0.45ms
AllReduce time increased accordingly
``` 
Zhen Wei: Also saw KV-cache interactions — recompute reshuffles execution timing and breaks some prefix-KV reuse heuristics, leading to extra KV loads from CPU/NVMe which amplifies comm cost.
Kevin Liu: Are we 100% sure kernel auto didn't fallback? Memory pressure can trigger a less-optimal kernel which would worsen forward time and hide overlap.
Maria Chen: Forced kernel=fused-opt and reran: forward improved (p99 down ~6% vs mem-saver default) but all-reduce remained elevated. Kernel helps but doesn't eliminate extra comm induced by recompute.
Sasha Patel: Mitigations to try: 1) smarter recompute placement to avoid PP boundary rematerialization; 2) change recompute order so local all-reduce can run concurrently; 3) bump micro-batch size to increase compute window for overlap.
Oliver Grant: Another idea — make our communicator perform async all-reduce (GPU-initiated, progress engine) so recompute work can proceed while reduce is in-flight. Harder but would buy overlap.
Maria Chen: Action items: Zhen to run a sweep this afternoon: (a) recompute on/off, (b) kernel fixed vs auto, (c) micro-batch sizes [1,2,4], (d) KV cache warm vs cold. Collect latencies, all-reduce times, mem peaks. Put results in /experiments/pp-tp-activation-tradeoffs (internal).
Zhen Wei: I'll run it — estimate 4-6h to get a matrix across our common seq distributions.
Kevin Liu: If recompute cost > memory win for our typical seq distribution we should consider flipping mem-saver default for PP configs. Flagging for next release decision.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Also let's add a small perf test in CI that runs TP/PP combo and flags >10% all-reduce inflation when mem-saver is enabled.
